text: dsh-media-gen 是面向 DSH Web 的图像与视频生成插件，复用 DSH 中配置的 OpenRouter provider 和凭据。它把图像、视频生成工具及 /image、/video 等命令接入对话，并提供聊天输入生成卡片、会话模型选择和设置页。用户可按模型能力填写提示词、尺寸、比例、时长等参数，生成的图像与视频保存到会话工作目录，视频任务在后台跟踪并可通知会话。适合希望直接在 DSH 对话中创作并复用媒体文件的用户。需要配置 OpenRouter provider 与 API 凭据；输入图像和生成请求会发送至 OpenRouter。

dsh-media-gen adds image and video generation to DSH Web using OpenRouter. Chat tools, commands, and model pickers accept prompts and options. Files save to the session workspace; video runs in the background. Prompts and input images are sent to OpenRouter, which requires a configured credential.

dsh-media-gen 的图像生成功能：通过对话工具或 /image 命令提交提示词，可选模型、比例、分辨率、seed 和参考图；生成结果保存到会话工作目录并显示在聊天中。
dsh-media-gen 的视频生成功能：通过视频工具或 /video 命令提交提示词，可设置时长、比例、分辨率、音频及首尾帧；后台跟踪任务并保存完成的视频。
dsh-media-gen 的聊天生成界面：输入框旁提供图像和视频模型选择及生成选项，并注册视频文件预览和生成结果的复用入口。
dsh-media-gen 使用 OpenRouter API 凭据提交生成请求；提示词和输入参考图会发送至 openrouter.ai。

dsh-media-gen README · Introduction：

dsh-media-gen README · dsh-media-gen：[English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

Generate images and videos in DeepSeek Harness (DSH), using the OpenRouter provider and API key already configured in DSH. **Only OpenRouter is supported.**

dsh-media-gen README · Features：- Ask the agent to write a model-specific prompt, or send your prompt unchanged through a generation card or command.
- Choose models per conversation, use input images, and reuse generated images for image or video generation.
- Save results in the working directory (`generated-media/` by default). Video jobs run in the background and notify their originating session.
- English and Japanese UI; command responses are English.

dsh-media-gen README · Compatibility：Choose a release for your DSH version from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen/releases). Supported versions and changes are recorded in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

dsh-media-gen README · Installation：Replace `<tag>` with the full release tag you selected:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-media-gen.git#<tag>'
```

The repository includes built files, so no local build is needed. It is private: your git must be authenticated with a GitHub account that has access. Replace `web` if you use another profile.

dsh-media-gen README · Installation：To update, run the same `add` command with the new tag and restart DSH. Omitting the tag installs the latest `main`, including unreleased changes; always specify a tag when reinstalling a particular release.

To remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-media-gen
```

Restart DSH after removal.

In DSH's Models settings, add an OpenRouter provider and save its API key.

dsh-media-gen README · Usage：

*From a chat request to a generated image, ready to reuse in another image or video. Presentation edited from a user-provided screenshot; the displayed cost is specific to this example.*

dsh-media-gen README · Generation cards and chat：Open **Generate…** beside the chat input and choose image/video, model, prompt, and available generation options.

- **Ask the agent** lets the agent write or translate your prompt and ask about missing details.
- **Generate as written** sends your text unchanged and starts a billable request. Check the displayed estimate first.

You can also ask directly in chat. For different image variants, ask for one prompt per image; `/image --count` instead repeats the same prompt.

dsh-media-gen README · Generation cards and chat：Generated images open in DSH's file preview. **Use for image** and **Use for video** open a card using the image as input (the first frame for video). **Use in chat** inserts its path and replaces the current draft.

Ask the agent to save model-specific prompt notes if needed. Notes persist across restarts and apply to all conversations; saving or clearing them always requires approval.

dsh-media-gen README · Commands：| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/image [--model id] [--aspect 1:1] [--resolution 1K] [--count n] [--seed n] [--image path]... [--yes] <prompt>` | Generate images; repeat `--image` for multiple inputs |
| `/video [--model id] [--duration seconds] [--aspect 16:9] [--resolution 720p] [--audio on\|off] [--seed n] [--first path] [--last path] [--ref path]... [--yes] <prompt>` | Submit a video job with optional first/last frames and reference images |
| `/media-jobs [job-id]` | List this session's video jobs or check one immediately |
| `/media-model` | Show selected models and defaults |
| `/media-model image` | List image model IDs |
| `/media-model image <model-id> [provider]` | Select a model for this conversation |
| `/media-model image default` | Clear the conversation selection |
| `/media-approval on` | Allow generation in this conversation without normal per-request confirmation |
| `/media-approval off` | Restore normal per-request confirmation |

dsh-media-gen README · Commands：Use `video` instead of `image` for video model selection. Chat-input selectors do the same thing; selections persist across restarts. The agent prioritizes the conversation selection over its own model argument, then uses configured defaults when no model is specified. Choosing a different card model through **Ask the agent** updates an existing conversation selection.

dsh-media-gen README · Approval and costs：Generation costs money. With `requireApproval` enabled and no conversation permission, agent requests ask for approval with the actual prompt and estimated cost; direct commands show only an estimate unless you add `--yes`. The chat input's **Media → Ask before generating** menu also controls conversation permission; only the user can change it.

dsh-media-gen README · Approval and costs：Agent tools always ask before sending images outside the working directory or making a second generation call in the same turn, even if normal confirmation is disabled. Direct commands follow `requireApproval`, `--yes`, and conversation permission instead; these extra agent checks do not apply to them.

dsh-media-gen README · Approval and costs：Estimates may be unknown or lower than the actual bill, especially for input-image or token charges. Required agent approvals still ask when an estimate cannot be obtained. After a timeout or unusable response, the provider may already have charged: check before retrying. If part of a multi-image request fails, already saved images are returned with the failure.

dsh-media-gen README · Video jobs：Jobs resume tracking after a DSH restart when storage is available. Completed files are downloaded automatically; completion, failure, or expiry is reported to the session when it is open. Jobs started with `/video` do not wake the agent on completion; use `/media-jobs` or wait for the next agent turn.

dsh-media-gen README · Video jobs：After `videoMaxWatchMs` (3 hours by default), tracking stops. This does **not** cancel the provider job or guarantee a refund. Ask the agent to check the job with `media_video_status` and its `job_id` to resume tracking.

dsh-media-gen README · Configuration：Open **Plugins → Media Generation → Components → Media Generation >** for model defaults, chat-menu models, limits, approval, and notifications. **All models…** can select a model outside your chat-menu filter; the agent can still list all models.

dsh-media-gen README · Configuration：| Setting | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `defaultImageProvider` / `defaultImageModel` | unset | Default image provider/model IDs |
| `defaultVideoProvider` / `defaultVideoModel` | unset | Default video provider/model IDs |
| `chatImageModels` / `chatVideoModels` | `[]` | Chat-menu model IDs; empty shows all |
| `maxImagesPerCall` | 4 | Images per call |
| `maxVideoSeconds` | 10 | Video duration limit; see Limitations |
| `requireApproval` | true | Normal per-generation confirmation |
| `outputDir` | `generated-media` | Relative output path within the working directory |
| `notifyOnVideoCompletion` | true | Notify the session when a video job ends |
dsh-media-gen README · Configuration：For polling, tracking, timeout, cache, and download-size settings, see the [configuration schema](src/index.ts).

dsh-media-gen README · Limitations：- Input images are sent to OpenRouter. Only PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF up to 20 MiB are accepted, and the model must support the requested input images or frames. API keys are not sent to the browser.
- Avoid common output-folder names such as `Pictures`. To display older outputs, the image route also accepts images in matching output folders without distinguishing working directories.
- Video previews support mp4, m4v, webm, and mov up to 32 MiB, independently of the download limit.
- When duration is omitted, `maxVideoSeconds` can limit the model's default only if its catalog lists supported durations.
- Without DSH storage, video tracking does not survive restarts.

dsh-media-gen README · Development：After cloning:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm check
```

`pnpm check` runs type checks, the build, tests, and CHANGELOG validation. To load the local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <absolute-path-to-clone>
```

After editing `src/`, run `pnpm build` and commit the generated `lib/` files with the source changes. Update both READMEs when usage changes; keep release and compatibility information in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).
